'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Daniel Stephens LS Endor''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Daniel Stephens]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor (Light)|Endor-L-endor.gif|label=Endor}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
